atlas.row_0: walk_pose: one walking pose (source clip frame 6) at 8 yaws, S..SE

atlas.pack_command: node tools/kam2/pack_atlas.mjs --in <frames> --out target/kam2-art/soldier --id unit.soldier --kind unit --facings 8 --anim walk_pose:1:10:true --anim walk:8:10:true --footprint 1x1 --pivot auto

notes: Sprite body is 34 px from ground to crown; the drawn silhouette is 37-38 px because the head's near top corner and the 26.565 deg tilt add depth. The alpha bbox is 42-43 px tall, which includes the baked contact shadow.
Widest facing (SW or SE) is 33 px, over the style-lock 24 px infantry box; the blocky character's arms are wide. The cell is 64 px so nothing clips.
The walk clip swings legs from the hip with no foot planting: frames 4 and 12 lift both feet 0.43 world units (about 6 px). The render is the clip as authored, no ground clamp was added.
No team mask pass: this look test renders the base sprite only.
